# Darkyan

Darkyan is a dark, minimalist theme with consistent contrast and readable typography. Subdued accents and unified interface elements keep the notes themselves prominent.

![Darkyan screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/johackim/obsidian-darkyan/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Darkyan"
    author: "johackim"
    repo:   "johackim/obsidian-darkyan"
    slug:   "darkyan"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/darkyan"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/johackim/obsidian-darkyan"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/johackim/obsidian-darkyan/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a dark, minimalist aesthetic to Obsidian with consistent contrast and readable typography. Keep notes prominent with subdued accents, unified UI elements, and a focus on simple, distraction-free styling."
}
```
